json_schema.title: service.restart
json_schema.description: restart the specified service with systemd

no_block.ui:title: No block
no_block.ui:description: Set to True to start the service using --no-block.

unmask.ui:title: Unmask
unmask.ui:description: Set to True to remove an indefinite mask before attempting to restart the service

unmask_runtime.ui:title: Unmask runtime
unmask_runtime.ui:description: Set to True to remove a runtime mask before attempting to restart the service.
